---

Their Microsoft Power Platform consultants specialise in business automation solutions and custom application development, and their nationwide team has 25+ years of experience helping businesses streamline operations with Power BI, Apps, Pages, and Automate solutions.
Their local team of Microsoft-certified Power Platform specialists offer expertise in Power Automate workflows, Power Apps creation, Power BI data visualisation, and Power Pages deployment.

Serving South Australian organisations, their Adelaide team develops Microsoft Power Platform solutions tailored to diverse business needs, designing automated workflows, custom applications, and data analytics solutions that address complex operational challenges and drive digital transformation.

### 2. 🥈 Ultron Developments — *Australian-Led, Adelaide-Supported Delivery*
**Website:** ultrondevelopments.com.au | **Phone:** 1300 967 494

Their Power Apps consulting team works with businesses in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and across Australia to design, build, test, and hand over custom applications on the Microsoft Power Platform.
They specialise in custom Canvas & Model-Driven apps, Dataverse architecture & governance, and offer a fixed-scope delivery plan.

Their services include custom canvas app development, model-driven app development, Power Automate workflow automation, legacy system modernisation, Dataverse & SharePoint integration, and ongoing support & training.
If your team relies on spreadsheets, paper forms, or outdated tools, they can map a practical replacement path.

**Best for:** Replacing paper-based or spreadsheet-driven processes in warehouse, field, and shop-floor environments with structured Dataverse apps.

Their consultants lead enterprise deployment, administration, and governance of the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem, and configure and manage Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio solutions.

**Best for:** Large enterprises in Adelaide needing governance, security, and enterprise-scale Power Platform deployments.

## 🔑 Key Capabilities to Look For (Relevant to Warehouse/Shop-Floor/Field Teams)

When evaluating any of these consultants, make sure they can deliver:

| Use Case | App Type |
|---|---|
| Field inspections & audits | Canvas mobile app with offline & photo capture |
| Inventory / asset tracking | Model-driven app + barcode scanning on Dataverse |
| Shop-floor job management | Canvas app with real-time status updates |
| Warehouse data capture | Mobile canvas app connected to SQL or Dataverse |
| Approval workflows | Power Automate + Canvas app |
Canvas apps are ideal for custom UI, mobile data capture, inspections, approvals, dashboards, and workflows — connected to Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, or APIs.
